name: ahepi-music
description: Tools for making narrated explainer films.

plugins.name: explainer-film
plugins.description: Make narrated, fact-checked explainer films for phone screens in a cinematic 2D+3D look, chapter by chapter, with calculators and a preflight check at every stage; places, sets and props built in Blender get real photographed surfaces, weeds and stones where they really grow, wear and believable construction by themselves, with batched variation rounds on rented cards.

plugins.name: painted-place
plugins.description: Build a place in Blender and bring it into the series' painted blue-hour look in one call - lights at every glowing window and lamp, sky rig, haze, AgX, a restrained paint filter, the street bundle's proven materials by role, laid setts on flat roads - then a blind judge says in plain words what to fix, once. Small by design; no gate stops a picture.
